# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

TidyFactor maintains security patches for the latest active major and minor releases of the Umbrella Suite and official AI Agent Skills.

| Version | Supported          |
| :---    | :---               |
| 1.5.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.4.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.4.0 | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security and integrity of TidyFactor architecture stacks and AI agent execution environments seriously.

If you discover a security vulnerability, supply chain issue, token leakage vector, or sandbox escape risk, **please do not disclose it publicly on GitHub issues or discussions.**

### Reporting Channels

1. **Email (Primary)**: Send encrypted or direct vulnerability details to [security@tidyfactor.com](mailto:security@tidyfactor.com) or [hello@tidyfactor.com](mailto:hello@tidyfactor.com).
2. **Private GitHub Vulnerability Reporting**: You may submit a private report via the [Security Advisories tab](https://github.com/TidyFactor/TidyFactor/security/advisories/new).

### Information to Include

Please provide:
- A clear description of the vulnerability and its attack vector.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept (PoC) code/prompts.
- Impact assessment (e.g. CLI arbitrary execution, prompt injection, RLS bypass).
- Any proposed remediation or mitigation.

### Response Timelines

- **Initial Acknowledgment**: Within 24 hours.
- **Triage & Validation**: Within 48 hours.
- **Patch Release & Advisory**: Within 7 business days depending on severity.
